    document.getElementById('back').onclick=()=>{orthographic=true;az=Math.PI;el=0;distance=fit;panX=0;panY=0;draw();};
    document.getElementById('side').onclick=()=>{orthographic=true;az=-Math.PI/2;el=0;distance=fit;panX=0;panY=0;draw();};
    document.getElementById('top').onclick=()=>{orthographic=true;az=0;el=Math.PI/2;distance=fit;panX=0;panY=0;draw();};
    document.getElementById('reset').onclick=()=>{orthographic=true;az=0;el=0;distance=fit;panX=0;panY=0;draw();};
    document.getElementById('waveAxis').onclick=()=>{orthographic=true;az=0;el=16*Math.PI/180;distance=fit;panX=0;panY=0;draw();};
    window.addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
  }
}
</script>

<script>
/* Edge panels are collapsible only on touch or narrow displays; leave CAD alone. */
(function(){
  const entries = [
    {button:'tabParts',panel:'legend',base:'Osad'},
    {button:'tabAppearance',panel:'sliders',base:'Vaade'},
    {button:'tabCup',panel:'cupControls',base:'Koost'},
    {button:'tabXlr',panel:'xlrControls',base:'XLR'}
  ];
  for(const e of entries){
    const b=document.getElementById(e.button), p=document.getElementById(e.panel);
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      const open=!p.classList.contains('is-open');
      for(const item of entries){
        const bt=document.getElementById(item.button), pan=document.getElementById(item.panel);
        pan.classList.remove('is-open');bt.classList.remove('is-open');
        bt.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');bt.textContent=item.base+(item.button==='tabParts'?' ▸':' ◂');
      }
      if(open){p.classList.add('is-open');b.classList.add('is-open');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');b.textContent=e.base+' ×';}
    });
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Local-only photo annotation. Native share is the closest available route to ChatGPT;
   an offline HTML file cannot attach a message to this conversation itself. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const view=document.getElementById('view'),labels=document.getElementById('coordsOverlay');
  const overlay=document.getElementById('drawOverlay'),pen=document.getElementById('penToggle');
  const clear=document.getElementById('clearPen'),photo=document.getElementById('photoShare');
  const status=document.getElementById('status'),ctx=overlay.getContext('2d');
  const strokes=[];let current=null, drawing=false;
  function notify(message){status.textContent=message;status.style.display='block';}
  function resize(){
    const rect=view.getBoundingClientRect(),ratio=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
    const newW=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.width*ratio)),newH=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.height*ratio));
    if(overlay.width!==newW||overlay.height!==newH){overlay.width=newW;overlay.height=newH;repaint();}
  }
  function point(e){const r=overlay.getBoundingClientRect();return [(e.clientX-r.left)/Math.max(1,r.width),(e.clientY-r.top)/Math.max(1,r.height)];}
  function repaint(){
    const w=overlay.width,h=overlay.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.strokeStyle='#ff3535';ctx.fillStyle='#ff3535';ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineWidth=3*(w/Math.max(1,overlay.clientWidth));
    for(const stroke of strokes){if(!stroke.length)continue;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(stroke[0][0]*w,stroke[0][1]*h);
      for(const p of stroke.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(p[0]*w,p[1]*h);
      if(stroke.length===1){ctx.arc(stroke[0][0]*w,stroke[0][1]*h,ctx.lineWidth/2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}else ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  function stop(){drawing=false;current=null;}
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    if(!overlay.classList.contains('drawing'))return;
    e.preventDefault();overlay.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);current=[point(e)];strokes.push(current);drawing=true;repaint();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drawing||!current)return;e.preventDefault();current.push(point(e));repaint();});
  overlay.addEventListener('pointerup',stop);overlay.addEventListener('pointercancel',stop);
  pen.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const enabled=pen.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true';
    pen.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(enabled));overlay.classList.toggle('drawing',enabled);
    clear.hidden=!enabled;pen.textContent=enabled?'✎ Valmis':'✎ Pliiats';stop();
  });
  clear.addEventListener('click',()=>{strokes.length=0;stop();repaint();});
  function capture(){
    resize();
    const out=document.createElement('canvas');out.width=view.width;out.height=view.height;
    const c=out.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
    c.drawImage(view,0,0,out.width,out.height);
    c.drawImage(labels,0,0,out.width,out.height);
    c.drawImage(overlay,0,0,out.width,out.height);
    return out;
  }
  function pngFile(out){
    const data=atob(out.toDataURL('image/png').split(',')[1]);
    const bytes=new Uint8Array(data.length);for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++)bytes[i]=data.charCodeAt(i);
    return new File([bytes],'Cubie_A7A_joonistus_'+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-')+'.png',{type:'image/png'});
  }
  function download(file){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(file);a.download=file.name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),12000);}
  photo.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    try{
      // Everything before navigator.share is synchronous to keep Android user activation.
      const file=pngFile(capture());
      if(navigator.share&&navigator.canShare&&navigator.canShare({files:[file]})){
        navigator.share({files:[file],title:'Cubie A7A – märgistatud foto'})
          .then(()=>notify('Jagamine lõpetatud. Vestlusesse jõudmist ei saa vaaturist kontrollida.'))
          .catch(e=>{if(e.name!=='AbortError'){download(file);notify('Jagamine ebaõnnestus; PNG salvestati. Lisa see vestlusesse.');}});
      } else {download(file);notify('PNG salvestati. Brauser ei saa seda otse vestlusse saata; lisa pilt siia.');}
    }catch(e){notify('Foto tegemine ebaõnnestus: '+String(e.message||e));}
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
